Hi Sara — great, thanks for the CIDR file. High-level list below; I've attached a compact handoff checklist and our recommended KMS key policy example. If you can confirm the items we can run a 30-minute technical handoff.

Redwood preflight checklist (short):
- Accounts & roles: please provide the AWS Account ID(s) we should trust. We'll ask you to create an IAM role with a trust policy we provide (Role name suggestion: RedwoodOnPremDeploymentRole).
- Networking: provide primary VPC CIDR, public/private subnet mapping, and any transit gateway/peering decisions. We will need a routable path between your customer DMZ and the on-prem host(s) or Transit Gateway connection.
- Firewall / ACLs: open outbound ports 443, 80 (for health checks and telemetry) and TCP 50051 for our internal agent management if using direct peering. Also allow incoming CIDR for Redwood probe IPs (we'll provide exact IP ranges during the call).
- NAT & DNS: confirm whether Helix will NAT egress traffic; provide DNS forwarders/conditional forwarders if you want Redwood to resolve internal hostnames.
- KMS: Redwood supports both Redwood-managed and BYOK. For BYOK, we require:
  * A symmetric KMS key with an alias (ex: alias/helix-redwood-byok)
  * Key policy granting root+specified admin users, and a principal for the pre-provisioned IAM role to use kms:Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. We attached an example policy (kms-key-policy.pdf).
- Audit & logging: please ensure S3 or an ELK endpoint is available for agent logs, or we can push to your CloudWatch (we need a minimal write policy).
- Certificates: if you run mTLS for agent control-plane, provide cert chain or agree to ACM-issued certs.

Attachments: hand-off-checklist.xlsx (Excel), kms-key-policy.pdf (PDF)

Proposed next steps:
1) Helix confirms Account ID(s) + intent to BYOK or Redwood-managed KMS
2) We share the IAM role trust policy and a CloudFormation template to pre-stage roles
3) Short handoff call (30 min) to exchange IPs/keys and run a connection test

Proposed call windows: 2026-10-12 10:00AM PT or 2026-10-12 2:00PM PT — please confirm.

Best,
Irene Choi
Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
